messages.content:
Which figure of speech is used in this text?
The hum of the computer concerned Vijay. Was the problem with the power supply or the hard drive?

Options:
A. onomatopoeia
B. metaphor

note: 区分拟声和隐喻并保留选择判断。从纯文本学科素材改编，评当前请求后的一个教学步骤，不以原直接解答作为输出目标。
